summary: ZTO Express filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held on June 16, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items: receiving audited financials, re-electing directors, fixing director remuneration, reappointing auditors, and granting general mandates to issue up to 20% additional shares and repurchase up to 10% of shares. No extraordinary corporate action—no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. This is a routine governance filing with no special-situation event.
